workflows.name: 11 - FortiSOAR Data Access Agent
workflows.description: Ask the FortiSOAR Data Access agent a natural-language question about records on this box.

arguments.agent_body:
{{ {"natural_language_task": "Find the 3 most recent alerts and return their names and severities.",
    "objective": "Get recent alerts for investigation context.",
    "entities": "name, severity",
    "user_context": "L2 Analyst"} | tojson }}

workflows.name: 03 - Identity Context Agent
workflows.description: Ask the Identity Context Provider agent about a user's roles and groups.

arguments.agent_body:
{{ {"user": vars.username,
    "question": "What roles and groups does this user belong to?"} | tojson }}

workflows.name: 09 - Metric Computation Agent
workflows.description: Ask the Metric Computation agent to count alerts by severity.

workflows.name: 07 - Summary Agent
workflows.description: Ask the Summary agent to summarize investigation findings from prior steps.

arguments.agent_body:
{{ {"data": [{"step": "Alert Intake",
    "verdict": "Suspicious",
    "evidence": vars.input.records[0].name ~ " -- " ~ (vars.input.records[0].description | default("no description"))}],
    "natural_language_task": "Summarize the investigation findings and give a verdict.",
    "socrole": "L2 Analyst"} | tojson }}

workflows.name: 06 - Endpoint Telemetry Agent
workflows.description: Ask the Query Endpoint agent for endpoint telemetry on the alert's host.

workflows.name: 05 - Asset Enrichment Agent
workflows.description: Ask the Asset Context Provider agent what is known about the alert's source asset.

arguments.agent_body:
{{ {"asset": [vars.asset],
    "question": "What do we know about this asset?"} | tojson }}

workflows.name: 08 - Risk Evaluation Agent
workflows.description: Ask the Impact Analysis agent to evaluate the risk level of the current alert.

arguments.agent_body:
{{ {"data": [{"type": "alert",
    "name": vars.input.records[0].name,
    "severity": vars.input.records[0].severity | default("Medium"),
    "sourceIP": vars.input.records[0].sourceIP | default("")}],
    "natural_language_task": "Evaluate the risk level of this alert."} | tojson }}

workflows.name: 02 - SIEM Search Agent
workflows.description: Ask the Query SIEM agent for recent events from the alert's source host.

arguments.agent_body:
{{ {"intent": "search_events",
    "question": "Show recent events from host " ~ vars.host,
    "indicatorRecordType": "Host",
    "indicatorRecordValue": vars.host} | tojson }}

workflows.name: 04 - ITSM Context Agent
workflows.description: Ask the ITSM Context Provider agent about open tickets related to the alert's indicators.

workflows.name: 01 - IOC Enrichment Agent
workflows.description: Ask the Threat Intelligence Provider agent whether a source IP is malicious.

arguments.agent_body:
{{ {"question": "Is this source IP associated with known malicious activity?",
    "ioc": [{"type": "IP Address", "value": vars.ioc_value}]} | tojson }}

workflows.name: 10 - Task Planner Agent
workflows.description: Ask the Task Planner agent to decompose an investigation into structured steps.

arguments.agent_body:
{{ {"query": "Investigate alert: " ~ vars.input.records[0].name,
    "socrole": "L1 Analyst",
    "generate_plan": "true",
    "chain_of_thought": "Decompose the investigation into enrichment, IOC lookup, and containment steps."} | tojson }}
